title: Mara onye ahịa gị, guzobe ngwa gị, jiri nọmba mee atụmatụ
course_title: Isi ahịa ahịa dijitalụ maka obere azụmaahịa

say: Mara onye ahịa gị, hazie ngwa gị, wee jiri nọmba mee atụmatụ.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul otu nke Digital Marketing Fundamentals: ndị ahịa, ọwa na atụmatụ.
Ịre ahịa bụ ihe niile ị na-eme iji nyere ndị ziri ezi aka ịchọpụta gị, tụkwasị gị obi, zụta ma laghachi azụ. Maapụ awara awara ahụ na-eme njem ahụ.
Mmata bụ mgbe mmadụ hụrụ post gị ma ọ bụ ụlọ ahịa gị na Google Maps maka oge mbụ.

panel.heading: Akwụkwọ ozi ma ọ bụ mgbasa ozi Facebook?
left: Ihe dịka puku naira iri abụọ

say: Nhọrọ B. Mgbasa ozi ihe dị ka puku naira iri ruru mmadụ puku asatọ, ihe dị ka puku naira iri abụọ na ise n'ime otu puku mmadụ, wee weta iwu ise.
Ya mere, ọ na-edobe akwụkwọ akụkọ ole na ole maka okporo ụzọ ya, ma na-ebuga ọtụtụ n'ime mmefu ego ya na mgbasa ozi. Ma cheta, iru abụghị ahịa. Soro ọwara ala ka ị nweta iwu tupu ị kpebie.

panel.heading: Na-arụ ọrụ azụ site na ebumnuche gị

cards.d: Ebumnuche SMART: nke akọwapụtara, enwere ike ịlele, enwere ike iru ya, dabara na ogologo oge.
Mmadụ 20 n'ime 100 ọ bụla na-akparịta ụka na usoro Bisi. Iwu 40 chọrọ nkata 200.
2 n'ime 100 ọ bụla na-ahụ posts ya na-eziga ozi. Mkparịta ụka 200 chọrọ mmadụ 10,000.

Na n'ime mmefu ego gị, na-emefu naanị ihe ị nwere ike imefu ka ị na-amụ ihe.
